tasks.title: Merge user data from three sources
tasks.objective: Read, parse, merge, and resolve conflicts from three user data sources (JSON, CSV, Parquet) with priority-based field resolution, generating merged parquet and conflict JSON.

factSources.description: Primary source: /data/source_a/users.json - JSON format, highest priority

outputContracts.description: Merged user dataset in Parquet format at /app/merged_users.parquet with columns: user_id (integer), name (string), email (string), created_date (string YYYY-MM-DD), status (string, optional).
Conflict report JSON at /app/conflicts.json with schema: {"total_conflicts": int, "conflicts": [{"user_id": int, "field": str, "values": {"source_a": value|null, ...}, "selected": value}]}

maps.title: Merge user data from three sources

nodes.title: Inspect input data sources
nodes.contextSummary: Read and understand the schema, field names, and data types of all three input files before implementing the merge solution.

nodes.title: Implement user data merge script
nodes.contextSummary: Read source_c parquet, map all field names to unified schema, merge by user_id with priority (a>b>c), generate merged_users.parquet and conflicts.json.

nodes.title: Smoke test merge script
nodes.contextSummary: Run merge_users.py from W:\app, verify merged_users.parquet and conflicts.json are generated with correct format and data.

nodes.title: Execute merge script and validate outputs
nodes.contextSummary: Run merge_users.py from W:\app, verify merged_users.parquet and conflicts.json are generated correctly. shell_command has 'unknown' action class in smoke_test but should work in implement_solution.

nodes.title: Validate merged output files
nodes.contextSummary: Run validation commands to verify merged_users.parquet and conflicts.json are correctly formatted and contain expected data.

nodes.contextSummary: Write test_merge_output.py for pytest validation of merged_users.parquet and conflicts.json.
